offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures pressure exchanger devices that recover hydraulic energy in seawater desalination and other industrial fluid processes. Sells to engineering firms, plant builders and operators of desalination plants and industrial gas and refrigeration systems. Also provides related pumps, spare parts and technical support.

primary_products.value: isobaric pressure exchangers; high-pressure pumps; CO2 refrigeration pressure exchangers; spare parts

primary_services.value: technical support and commissioning; maintenance and aftermarket service; equipment repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: desalination plant builders, EPC contractors, plant operators, refrigeration OEMs and industrial process companies; B2G: municipal and state-owned water utilities buying desalination plants, often via contractors

end_markets.value: water desalination; industrial wastewater; commercial refrigeration; oil and gas processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: pressure exchangers, pumps and related equipment; project or contract: large equipment orders for desalination plant projects; service fees: spare parts, technical support and aftermarket service; licensing or royalties: licensing of technology in some arrangements
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures ceramic-based pressure exchangers and pumps for plant builders, operators and refrigeration OEMs; component supplier: supplies key energy recovery components to desalination and refrigeration system builders

geography_served.value: global: Middle East, Asia, Europe, Americas and Africa, with manufacturing in San Leandro, California

specialization.value: related lines: pressure exchangers for desalination, CO2 refrigeration and industrial processes, plus pumps and parts

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to EPC contractors, plant operators and OEMs; agents / brokers: regional sales representatives and agents in international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules plus export, trade and equipment safety standards, no operating licenses
